profile.headline: Software Engineer, Sr. at PNC
profile.summary: Dedicated and results-oriented professional with a proven track record in adeptness in leveraging technology to drive business success. With a passion for cultivating cohesive teams and fostering a collaborative work environment, I thrive in roles where I can inspire others towards achieving shared goals. My proficiency extends across various technological platforms and tools, allowing me to streamline processes, enhance productivity, and deliver innovative solutions that propel organizational growth. With a commitment to continuous learning and development, I embrace challenges with enthusiasm and approach them with a strategic mindset.

positions.title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
positions.description:
• Planned & implemented Domain Separation from the ground up, ensuring that instance data is securely segregated between different customers.
• Designed & configured complex structural access control groundwork with inherited roles, groups, and ACLs to ensure that the principle of least privilege is followed, while guaranteeing the ability for customer requirements to be easily implemented in the domain-separated instance.
• Created foundational documentation templates for both internal and external use including functional/technical specifications, project timeline, project plan, presentations, and supporting documents related to project phases.

positions.title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and configured Visitor Management process using ServiceNow's Workplace Visitor Management/Core modules.
• Created a custom scoped application for Marketing Project requests/approvals.
• Implemented catering request form into ServiceNow platform for efficiency and reporting.
• Assisted with platform upgrade (Washington to Xanadu), identified security enhancements, and provided best-practice recommendations.

positions.title: Information Technology Analyst / ServiceNow Developer
positions.description:
- Standard ServiceNow Development (Workflows/Flows/Actions, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies/Actions, ACLs, etc.) 
- Advanced ServiceNow Development (Custom scripts [JavaScript/PowerShell/etc.], Spoke Development, Data Modeling, Advanced Reporting, Custom REST/SOAP API Development/Implementation, GPT Integration, etc.)
- Custom Windows Forms Development (Primarily to handle various tasks within the Microsoft ecosystem)
positions.insights: Skills: IT Operations Management · IT Service Management · Requirements Gathering · Digital Transformation · Stakeholder Engagement · JavaScript · Solution Architecture
